title: Failed Request Deep-dive: payload inspector + retry timeline prototype
creator: Ava Patel
description: Problem: Operators and engineers frequently struggle to triage intermittent failed inference requests in the Redwood Console. Current traces surface raw error codes but make it hard to correlate retry dynamics, payload differences, and upstream causes. Goal: design a lightweight, actionable "Failed Request Deep-dive" panel that surfaces an error taxonomy tree, a compact retry timeline with sparkline latency and token counts, and an inline payload inspector that highlights diffs between retried attempts and canonical payloads. This ticket covers low-fidelity exploration, interaction specs, and a clickable Figma prototype for PM/Eng review. Success metrics: - Reduce median time-to-diagnosis for customer-reported failed requests by 30% in internal playtests. - >= 80% of engineers report the new panel helps them determine next action (retry, escalate, rollback). - Prototype passes usability critique with core infra and support teams. Out of scope: full RBAC/audit implementation (handled by Private team), long-term storage UX for multi-day forensic review.
acceptance_criteria: Clickable Figma prototype with annotated flows for 'single failure' and 'flapping retries' scenarios
Design spec describing data contract required (fields, snapshot diffs, retry metadata) for ENG-34821
Front-end interaction document with edge-case behaviors (large payloads, truncated diffs, binary attachments)
Stakeholder sign-off from PM (Sofia Ramirez) and runtime engineering lead (Priya Kapoor)
tasks: Draft three candidate layouts: vertical split, tabbed inspector, and overlay flyout
Create error taxonomy visual (clustered tree with filter chips) and map to backend codes
Design retry timeline: compact row per request with sparkline latency + retry count badge
Define payload diff UX: inline highlighted tokens, side-by-side mode, and 'show raw' toggle
Produce Figma prototype and link to PRD in Confluence
Run 2 internal usability sessions with SRE and Solutions teams
comments: 2025-01-13 - Ava Patel: Initial problem framing posted. Pulled logs from recent incidents (2024-12 flapping model serving) to identify common patterns. Decided to prioritize quick-read summary rather than full forensic timeline in MVP.
2025-01-16 - Liam Chen: Completed three wireframe variants. Engineering warned large side-by-side diffs could be heavy; asked for a compact inline-first approach with an optional full-diff overlay.

2025-01-20 - Priya Kapoor (Eng): Confirmed required backend metadata fields: request_id, attempt_index, error_code, latency_ms, token_count, model_variant, prefix_cache_key, kv_cache_state, base_payload_sha, payload_snapshot_url. ENG-34821 owns exposing these fields. Noted pagination constraints for bursty traces.

2025-01-24 - Sofia Ramirez (PM): Reviewed concepts. Likes retry timeline and taxonomy filter chips. Requested adding a 'Suspected cause' heuristic (client payload mismatch, model OOM, routing fallback) that surfaces as a first-pass label for support engineers.

2025-01-27 - Design critique notes: Use condensed sparklines with tooltip details on hover; color palette must pass accessibility contrast with error/highlight states. Avoid heavy animation that obscures quick scanning.

2025-01-30 - Liam Chen: Built Figma prototype (link above). Added interactions: click retry bubble -> open payload inspector; click taxonomy node -> filter requests; keyboard shortcut 'D' to open deep-dive for selected trace.

2025-02-01 - QA (Jordan Reeves): Requested edge-case behavior: if payload snapshot is missing, show 'snapshot not available' and offer 'reconstruct from KV' action leading to ENG ticket. Also reported performance concern rendering diffs for >50KB payloads.

2025-02-02 - Ava Patel: Updated design to include payload size guardrails (show summary for >20KB, with button to fetch full snapshot), and added 'render as text/JSON/plain' toggles. Preparing handoff doc for ENG-34821 and ENG-35672 (pagination backend).
